key.name: magnification-enabled
key.description: Grow the icon under the pointer and push the neighbouring icons aside.

key.name: magnification-strength
key.description: How much the icon under the pointer grows. 0.45 means 1.45 times the normal icon size.

key.name: magnification-radius
key.description: How many icons around the pointer are affected, in icon widths.

key.name: hover-highlight
key.summary: Highlight the icon under the pointer
key.description: Provided by Dash to Dock: a light rounded background behind the icon under the pointer. Turn it off to keep the dock completely unchanged while the magnification is active.

key.name: folder-enabled
key.summary: Show a folder on the dock
key.description: Add a folder button at the end of the dock. Clicking it opens a list with the newest files of the folder below.

key.name: folder-path
key.description: Absolute path of the folder whose contents are shown in the list.

key.name: folder-count
key.summary: Number of files in the menu
key.description: How many files of the folder are shown in the list: 5 or 10. The newest files come first.

key.name: folder-tilt
key.description: How far the list opens like a hand fan. 0 keeps the names straight and the list compact, 15 to 30 turn the rows around their icon.

key.name: folder-icon
key.description: Name of an icon of the current icon theme, or the absolute path of an image file on the computer.
